title: Approvals
description: Confirm accounts created by monitors and members, manage invitation links and the pre-approved list.

pending.intro: These people signed up with an invitation link. They can sign in but can't access anything until you confirm their role.
pending.selected: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
pending.approveTitle: {count, plural, one {Approve this account?} other {Approve these # accounts?}}
pending.approveText: Each person gets the requested role and a member record is created for them.
pending.rejectTitle: {count, plural, one {Reject this account?} other {Reject these # accounts?}}
pending.rejectText: These people won't be able to sign in any more. They will see a message saying their request was declined.
pending.approved: {count, plural, =0 {No account approved} one {# account approved} other {# accounts approved}}
pending.rejected: {count, plural, =0 {No account rejected} one {# account rejected} other {# accounts rejected}}
pending.emptyHint: Sign-ups made with an invitation link will show up here.
pending.unknown: No record with this e-mail or phone

invitations.intro: Share a link so monitors or members can create their account. Accounts created with a link stay pending until you approve them.
invitations.label: Label (optional)
invitations.createdText: For security, this link will never be shown again. Copy it now and share it (WhatsApp, e-mail…).
invitations.copyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the link and copy it by hand.
invitations.revokeText: Nobody will be able to sign up with this link any more. Accounts already created are not affected.
invitations.emptyHint: Create a link so monitors can sign up.

preapproved.intro: When someone on this list creates their account with the same e-mail or phone, they get their role immediately, without approval.
preapproved.format: One person per line: Name; email; phone. Separator: semicolon, comma or tab. Email or phone may be empty, but not both.
preapproved.added: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody added} one {# person added} other {# people added}}
preapproved.duplicates: {count, plural, one {# duplicate skipped (line {lines})} other {# duplicates skipped (lines {lines})}}
preapproved.existing: {count, plural, one {# person already has an account (line {lines})} other {# people already have an account (lines {lines})}}: give them the role in Settings → Users.
preapproved.invalid: {count, plural, one {# invalid line} other {# invalid lines}}
preapproved.deleteTitle: Remove this person from the list?
preapproved.deleteText: If they sign up later, they'll get a parent account (or a pending one with an invitation link).
preapproved.emptyHint: Import the monitors and members you already know.

notify.approvedBody: Welcome to the ONET Teboulba team: your space is now available.
